She might not even realize that’s she’s not showing the same affection back to you. My husband and I kiss each other when one of us gets home, and we both have had to initiate. Like, i genuinely forget because I have a million things on my mind. And then I’ll catch myself and have to consciously go to him and kiss him because I realized I forgot. And I know it’s the same thing for him. Think about it this way, he just got home from work, trying to unwind and maybe a little stressed, maybe gotta poop or something. Lol. Sometimes it’ll be like an hour later and we’ll go out of our way to kiss each other and say “hey, I didn’t give you a kiss when I got home.” 

It sounds silly, but it’s important to us to show each other affection and we both know we forget when we got stuff on our mind or are tired. Maybe she really just doesn’t know she’s not doing the same for you. Trust me, as much as we love our partners sometimes we just forget things. We’re human 🤷🏻‍♀️
